docs.title: Marcos Cunha
docs.text: Hello! I'm Marcos Cunha, an engineer passionate about embedded systems and artificial intelligence. I enjoy exploring innovative solutions, sharing my projects, and contributing to the open-source community.

docs.title: About Me
docs.text: With a strong background in engineering, I specialize in developing cutting-edge solutions in embedded systems and AI. My work focuses on combining these fields to create impactful and efficient technologies, while staying active in local and international tech communities. You can often find me at FOSDEM or at Toulouse Data Science meetup sessions, feel free to say hello.

docs.title: Community & Events
docs.text:
• Toulouse Data Science Association (Active Member): Participate in meetups and knowledge-sharing activities in Toulouse, France.

Feel free to connect with me on LinkedIn to learn more about my professional journey and interests.

docs.title: Projects
docs.text:
• Carcara-NVC: A project showcasing expertise in embedded systems, focusing on performance and efficiency.

Thank you for visiting my site! Stay tuned for more updates and projects.

docs.title: Projects
docs.text:
Here is a list of my GitHub repositories with quick context:

  • Carcara-NVC: Network Video Controller with ML-powered detection. Focus on embedded performance and efficient inference.
  • Axelera AI - Pioneer 10 Challenge: Summer Sidekick challenge project. Explores applied AI prototyping and community-driven experimentation.

For more, visit my GitHub profile.
